text_block_list.text:
After training,
I handed Line Craft a fan letter.
She immediately began reading it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"‘Watching you always look straight ahead and run with such
single-minded determination gave me courage. I'll do my best too’..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ehehehe. Having it written out so frankly
makes me a little shy~

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Still, the child in this letter...
might be just like how I used to be...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Seeing all the Tiara Umamusume gave me courage, too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's not just from the old days,
I'm still getting them now, though...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"The child who wrote the letter felt
the same way I did back then..."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I know! I just had a great idea♪
The next day, I spotted Rhein Kraft in the cafeteria, hard at work making something.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's a wire craft charm!
I was thinking of including it in my replies to fan letters.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"The girl who wrote the letter told me
she gained courage from watching me run."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Still, courage is such a fickle thing,
and it can disappear before you even know it.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
So, I was hoping this charm could remind you
of your courage whenever I'm not around!
choice_data_list: I see. That's a great idea!
I see. That's a great idea!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Also... I just wanted to leave something behind.
Proof of who I am... in the hands of my fans.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... Well then,
guess I'll finish this up in one go~.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
It's ready~!
Here is my reply, complete with a handcrafted
Craft charm for courage!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
May this charm bring courage
to the child who wrote the letter.
Rhein Kraft poured all her heartfelt wishes into preparing her reply to the fan letter.
